style:
Use case: ui-mockup for a product launcher gallery card. One landscape 1376x768 image in the "Ethereal Tech Dark Mockup" style: deep zinc canvas from #09090b at the edges to #18181b, a faint warm orange radial glow bleeding in from one corner, glassmorphic panels with thin soft borders, rounded corners and soft shadows, orange #f97316 only for selected and interactive states, clean white sans-serif interface text with a clear hierarchy, generous margins. A refined, idealised interface mockup, not a screenshot, no browser chrome, no operating-system chrome.

The reference images are the real content and must be reproduced faithfully. The character is THIS exact ox: a round chubby pale blue-grey ox calf with no visible neck, small rounded ears, two short cream horns, a single curl of hair on top of the head, big droopy dark eyes under worried brows, a wide cream muzzle with two small nostrils, a thin mint-green collar with a small square cream tag showing a tiny ox-face silhouette, short stubby legs with dark grey hooves; thick clean dark outlines, flat colours, and a white die-cut sticker border around each sticker. Do not substitute another cow, a realistic cow, a black-and-white spotted cow, or change its colours. Each sticker's Chinese caption is lettered under the ox in thick bold black rounded characters with a white outline, exactly as in the reference; copy every Chinese character stroke for stroke and add no other text inside the stickers.
note: Each prompt is `style` + the image prompt below. References are built from the shipped seed; scratch copies are not shipped. Finals were flattened to opaque RGB and compressed with pngquant --quality=85-100 --speed 1.

hero.png.prompt:
Layout — the Sticker Pack workspace of Pneuma in action, a wide dark app window filling the frame:
- Top bar of the window: a small orange rounded-square sticker icon, the pack title "打工牛马" in white with the small grey subtitle "8 stickers · 8 ready" under it; a segmented control with three tabs "Panel" (selected, orange tint), "Chat", "Submit"; on the far right a small segmented toggle "Light | Dark" with "Dark" selected.
- Left column (narrow): a glass card headed "CHARACTER" in small grey uppercase letters, showing the ox from the first reference standing large and centred; under it three small outlined chips "WeChat", "Telegram", "LINE".
- Centre (the largest area): a 4 by 2 grid of eight dark rounded sticker cards in this exact order, left to right, top row then bottom row, each showing one sticker from the second reference with its caption: 01 收到 (saluting), 02 马上 (running with speed lines and a sweat drop), 03 稍等 (one hoof raised), 04 辛苦了 (bowing, eyes closed), 05 加班中 (exhausted, droopy eyes), 06 摸鱼 (hugging a blue fish), 07 下班啦 (jumping for joy, mouth open), 08 不想上班 (bawling with streams of blue tears). Each card has a tiny grey monospace number 01–08 in its top-left corner and a small green pill "Ready" at its bottom. Card 01 has a glowing orange selection border. The stickers are big and crisp — they are the hero of the picture.
- Right edge: a slim glass agent chat panel with two short bubbles: the user's bubble (orange-tinted, right-aligned) "A sticker pack of our ox for the work group chat" and the agent's reply (grey, left-aligned) "Eight stickers, all drawn from one character." and an empty message input at the bottom.
references: the eight stickers on #111111 in pack order, 4x2 (frames ffmpeg-extracted from the picked takes (modes/sticker/seed/niuma/stickers/sNN/take-N.gif, -fps_mode passthrough): s01 #10, s02 #11, s03 #5, s04 #6, s05 (take-2) #2, s06 #6, s07 #7, s08 #10 (1-based))

- A short glowing orange arrow pointing right.
- Centre-left: a larger glass card headed "CHARACTER" showing reference (2) big and centred on a dark tile, with a small orange-outlined chip under it reading "drawn once".

Each tile has a tiny grey monospace number 01–08 in its top-left corner. Above the grid a small grey label: "8 stickers · looping GIFs".

- No headline, title or subtitle anywhere in the picture: the only words are the labels named above, the eight captions and the bottom line. Give the three stages the full height of the frame instead.

highlight-platform-checks.png.prompt:
Reference image: the 收到 sticker (saluting ox with the caption 收到), on a dark chat plate.

Layout — one idea: one export, three stores, each checked against its own rules. Three equal glass columns side by side, one per store, each a checklist card:
- Column header: the store name in white — "WeChat", "Telegram", "LINE" — and next to it a small summary pill. WeChat: green "19 pass" and grey "0 fail". Telegram: green "15 pass" and grey "0 fail". LINE: green "17 pass", amber "1 warning" and grey "0 fail".
- Under the header, a small dark tile showing the same 收到 sticker from the reference, with a tiny monospace file chip beside it: WeChat "01.gif · 240×240", Telegram "01.webm · 512×512", LINE "01.png · APNG".
- Then six checklist rows per column, each with a small green check mark, in small clean white text (secondary details in grey):
  WeChat: "GIF 240×240 · loops forever" / "319–411 KB each · limit 500 KB" / "cover 240×240 · icon 50×50" / "banner 750×400" / "name, intro, copyright" / "wechat.zip · 11 files"
  Telegram: "WEBM VP9 + alpha · 512×512" / "173–237 KB each · limit 256 KB" / "1.93 s at 30 fps · limit 3 s" / "one emoji per sticker" / "thumbnail 100×100" / "telegram.zip · 9 files"
  LINE: "APNG within 320×270" / "412–505 KB each · limit 1 MB" / "16 frames · 1.92 s × 2 plays" / "main 240×240 · tab 96×74" / "title, description, copyright" / and a last row with a small amber triangle instead of a check: "ZIP file names — confirm on the upload page"
- Below the columns, left: an orange button "Export all"; right of it, small grey text "8 stickers · 3 upload zips · listing text to paste".
- No headline, title or subtitle anywhere else. Spell every English word and number exactly as given; the only Chinese characters in the picture are the sticker caption 收到.
highlight-platform-checks.png.numbers: every count, size and limit is from `sticker.mjs export --platform all` then `check --platform all` on a copy of the seed (2026-11-06): WeChat 19 pass, Telegram 15 pass, LINE 17 pass + 1 warning, 0 fail

calls.why: came back RGBA with alpha 12-253 although no transparency was asked for; flattened onto #09090b

Keep everything else in the image exactly as it is: the three columns, every row of text and every number, the pills, the three 收到 stickers and their captions, the colours and the composition.
